identity.title: Focus Lab™
identity.focus: Investigate one real focus pattern using evidence.

investigations.title: The Hook
investigations.mission: Notice what happens before a focus choice.

prompts.label: Your prediction
prompts.prompt: Before anything is explained, what do you think is driving this focus moment, and what do you predict will happen next?
prompts.placeholder: Commit to your current explanation before the reveal…

prompts.label: Repeated pattern
prompts.prompt: Which focus pattern has repeated, and what specific example from the last seven days shows that it actually happened?
prompts.placeholder: Name the pattern and one concrete trace…

investigations.title: The Revelation
investigations.mission: Look for evidence that changes your first explanation.

prompts.label: What the evidence changes
prompts.prompt: Which part of your first explanation does the revealed principle now challenge, support or complicate?
prompts.placeholder: Compare the reveal with what you predicted…

prompts.label: Focus map
prompts.prompt: Map one real focus moment: what happened before it, what you did, what competed for attention, and what happened next?
prompts.placeholder: Use one real moment rather than a general description…

prompts.label: Working equation
prompts.prompt: Write a simple working explanation for what appears to increase or reduce your focus.
prompts.placeholder: Write a relationship you can actually test…

prompts.label: Falsification test
prompts.prompt: What would you need to observe for this working explanation to be wrong or incomplete?
prompts.placeholder: Name evidence that would force you to revise it…

investigations.title: Contract
investigations.mission: Choose what you will test in real life.

prompts.label: Action to test
prompts.prompt: What specific focus action will you test when the target situation occurs?

prompts.label: Witness or accountability
prompts.prompt: Who or what will help you verify that the test actually happened?

prompts.label: Minimum version
prompts.prompt: What is the smallest version of the action that still counts as completing the test?

prompts.label: Failure signal
prompts.prompt: What observable signal will tell you that the test did not happen as designed?

prompts.label: Restart response
prompts.prompt: If the test breaks, what will you do at the next opportunity instead of abandoning it?

prompts.label: Predicted adherence
prompts.prompt: Before the experiment begins, what percentage of real opportunities do you predict you will follow through on?

prompts.label: Experiment observation
prompts.prompt: For the opportunity you are recording, what happened, what action did you take, and what evidence shows the outcome?
prompts.placeholder: Record the event, action and result without polishing it…

investigations.title: Evidence Review
investigations.mission: Review the evidence without forcing a conclusion.

prompts.label: Evidence that supported the explanation
prompts.prompt: Which observation most strongly supported your original working explanation?

prompts.label: Evidence that challenged the explanation
prompts.prompt: Which observation most strongly challenged, contradicted or complicated your original explanation?

prompts.label: Assumption to revise
prompts.prompt: Which assumption from the beginning of the Lab is now harder to defend, and why?

prompts.label: Transfer test
prompts.prompt: Where else would this focus principle need to hold before you would trust it beyond this experiment?

investigations.title: Behaviour Profile
investigations.mission: Bring the evidence together into a behaviour profile.

prompts.label: What I observed
prompts.prompt: What can you now say you actually observed, rather than assumed?

prompts.label: What changed
prompts.prompt: What changed between your starting prediction and the evidence you collected?

prompts.label: What remains uncertain
prompts.prompt: What remains uncertain or untested after this Lab?

prompts.label: What I will test next
prompts.prompt: What is the next focus pattern, context or assumption worth testing?
